# uzc_network (Data Source)

Looks up a single UzCloud network by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_network" "example" {
  slug = "example-network"
}

output "network_id" {
  value = data.uzc_network.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) UzCloud's internal UUID for this network.
- `name` (String)
- `service_name` (String)
- `shared` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
